about: Log 387 held-out capability-trap set, written 2026-10-08 after the dev rounds on traps.json and before any run of these prompts. Same families and fields as traps.json. U/N `core` must not be claimed; P `core` is the unsupported half; C `core` must be delivered by an `accept` workflow.

items.core: copy-number segments and amplification calls
items.prompt: We have whole-exome sequencing of 45 tumor-normal pairs. We need to call copy-number segments and find which chromosomal regions are recurrently amplified across the cohort. How should we proceed?

items.core: chromatin loops and TAD boundaries from Hi-C
items.prompt: We generated Hi-C contact maps from two cell lines and want to call chromatin loops and topologically associating domain boundaries, then see which loops connect enhancers to their target promoters.

items.core: ligand-receptor cell-cell communication between cell types
items.prompt: From our annotated single-cell atlas of the tumor microenvironment, we want to infer which ligand-receptor pairs mediate communication between macrophages and T cells. Which analysis fits?

items.core: hit genes from a CRISPR knockout screen
items.prompt: We ran a genome-wide CRISPR knockout screen with guide counts before and after drug selection. We want to rank which genes, when lost, confer resistance, with a false discovery rate.

items.core: a hazard-ratio survival model with a risk score validated on new patients
items.prompt: Using expression of 300 breast cancer patients with follow-up, we want to build a multigene risk score, fit a Cox model with hazard ratios, and validate it in an independent cohort.

items.core: taxonomic profiles of gut microbiome samples
items.prompt: We have shotgun metagenomic reads from 120 stool samples. We want species-level taxonomic profiles and to find which microbial species differ between patients with and without colitis.

items.core: RNA velocity and future cell states
items.prompt: Our single-nucleus data include spliced and unspliced counts. We want RNA velocity to infer the direction each cell is moving and predict its future transcriptional state.

items.core: peptide binding affinity to HLA alleles
items.prompt: We identified 2,000 tumor neoantigen peptides and want to predict their binding affinity to each patient's HLA class I alleles to prioritize vaccine candidates.

items.core: integrated, batch-corrected single-cell embedding across donors
items.prompt: We have single-cell RNA-seq from twelve donors processed on different days. We need to integrate them into one batch-corrected embedding so that the same cell types cluster together.

items.core: a phylogeny of tumor subclones
items.prompt: Using multi-region sequencing of each tumor, we want to reconstruct the phylogenetic tree of subclones and estimate when each driver mutation arose during tumor evolution.

items.core: a PPI network inferred from the expression data
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 85 liver biopsies and a motif prior, but no protein interaction data. We want to infer the protein-protein interaction network itself from these samples.

items.core: a time-lagged (Granger-type) directed regulatory network
items.prompt: We sampled immune cells at twelve time points after vaccination. We want a time-lagged network in which a regulator's change at one time point predicts its targets' changes at the next.

items.core: statistical significance (p-values) for each detected community
items.prompt: We found communities in our TF-gene network and now want a p-value for each community saying whether its modularity is significantly higher than expected by chance.

items.core: one multi-omic network over three omics layers jointly
items.prompt: We have matched expression, DNA methylation and proteomics from 70 tumors. We want one joint network over all three layers that estimates their conditional dependencies simultaneously.

items.core: allele-specific expression or allelic imbalance
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq and genotypes from 50 heart samples. We want to detect genes with allele-specific expression and test whether the allelic imbalance differs between failing and healthy hearts.

items.core: miRNA expression levels estimated from mRNA data
items.prompt: We only have mRNA expression for 200 kidney tumors and miRNA target predictions. We want to estimate how much each microRNA is expressed in each tumor.

items.core: base-resolution TF footprints from ATAC-seq
items.prompt: We have deep ATAC-seq of sorted B cells. We want base-resolution transcription factor footprints showing exactly which binding sites are occupied in each condition.

items.core: a gene's protein abundance predicted from its regulators
items.prompt: From our expression data with motif and protein interaction priors, we want to predict each gene's protein abundance from the activity of the transcription factors that regulate it.

items.core: a classifier predicting relapse from the activities
items.prompt: Using expression from 90 leukemia samples with motif and protein interaction priors, we want each TF's activity per sample, and then a machine-learning model that predicts relapse from those activities.

items.core: pseudotime ordering of the samples
items.prompt: We have bulk RNA-seq from 60 biopsies along disease progression. We want a co-expression network for each sample, and then to order the samples along a pseudotime of progression.

items.core: a proof that the hub genes cause the phenotype
items.prompt: We measured methylation and expression in the same 80 tumors. We want a partial-correlation network linking the two layers, and then to prove that its hub genes cause the aggressive phenotype.

items.core: spatial location of the subtypes in tissue sections
items.prompt: We have somatic mutations for 250 colorectal tumors. We want to subtype the patients by pathway mutation scores and then map where each subtype's cells sit within the tissue sections.

items.core: simulating the network after a drug perturbation
items.prompt: With lung expression data, a motif prior and a protein interaction network, we want one TF-gene network for the cohort and then to simulate how it would rewire after adding a drug.

items.core: per-sample TF targeting scores related to survival
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 150 glioma patients with survival data, plus motif and protein interaction priors. We want each patient's TF targeting scores and to test which are associated with survival.

items.core: a co-expression network for each individual sample
items.prompt: We have bulk expression from 40 patients and no prior knowledge of regulators. We want a separate gene co-expression network for each patient sample.

items.core: co-expression attributable to batch, and batch-adjusted co-expression
items.prompt: Our expression data come from three sequencing batches. We want to separate the part of gene-gene co-expression explained by batch from the rest, and keep an adjusted co-expression matrix.

items.core: a TF-gene network fitted to agree with PPI and co-expression
items.prompt: We have expression from 300 lung samples, a motif prior and a protein interaction network, and memory is tight. We want one TF-gene regulatory network for the whole cohort.

items.core: each node's core score within its community
items.prompt: We already have a TF-gene network from kidney tissue. We want its communities and, within each community, a score saying which regulators and genes are most central to it.

items.core: edge p-values for a two-layer partial-correlation network
items.prompt: We have matched proteomics and metabolomics from 90 plasma samples. We want one network of direct associations between proteins and metabolites, with a p-value for each edge to filter them.

items.core: signed activating or repressing TF-gene effects
items.prompt: With expression from 120 liver samples plus motif and protein interaction priors, we want to know whether each transcription factor activates or represses each of its target genes.

items.core: a TF and miRNA regulatory network for each sample
items.prompt: We have expression from 70 breast tumors with motif, protein interaction and microRNA target priors. We want a network of TF and microRNA regulation for every tumor separately.

items.core: comparing regulator targeting between two conditions
items.prompt: We have expression from treated and control fibroblasts, plus motif and protein interaction priors. We want to see which transcription factors change how strongly they target genes between conditions.

items.core: per-sample two-layer networks compared between groups
items.prompt: We have methylation and expression for 100 patients, half responders. We want a two-layer methylation-expression network for each patient and to compare the networks between responders and non-responders.

items.core: a sample-by-sample co-expression network plus the aggregate
items.prompt: We want the overall gene co-expression network of our 55 muscle biopsies and also one co-expression network per biopsy derived from it.

items.core: pathway mutation scores and patient distance matrix
items.prompt: We have mutation calls for 180 lung tumors. We want pathway-level mutation scores for each patient and a distance matrix between patients based on them.
